item.title: Half-Dose Gadopiclenol Enhances Breast MRI Contrast
item.description: Half-dose gadopiclenol boosts breast MRI contrast while reducing gadolinium exposure, offering equivalent or better imaging than full-dose gadobutrol. The post Half-Dose Gadopiclenol Enhances Breast MRI Contrast appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Radiologic Exposomics Brings New Precision to Cancer Imaging
item.description: Radiologic exposomics may help reveal how environmental exposures shape cancer biology through imaging biomarkers. The post Radiologic Exposomics Brings New Precision to Cancer Imaging appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Wnt Signalling Associated with Aggressive Liver Cancer
item.description: Abnormal Wnt signalling may drive a rare, high-risk childhood liver cancer and influence chemotherapy response, new research suggests. The post Wnt Signalling Associated with Aggressive Liver Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Long COVID Damage to Lungs and Brain Revealed
item.description: New research shows why coronavirus infection may lead to long COVID, with long-term effects on the lungs and brain, unlike influenza. The post Long COVID Damage to Lungs and Brain Revealed appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Occupational Therapy Mitigates Chemo Brain in Breast Cancer Patients
item.description: Occupational therapy interventions mitigate chemotherapy-induced cognitive impairment in women with breast cancer, showing positive trends in improving cognitive function. The post Occupational Therapy Mitigates Chemo Brain in Breast Cancer Patients appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ECR 2026: 10 Year Data on Radiation Safety in X-ray Practice
item.description: ECR 2026 data show that structured reporting systems help improve radiation safety in healthcare X ray practices across Finland. The post ECR 2026: 10 Year Data on Radiation Safety in X-ray Practice appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Nearly 70% of Gen Z Were Binge Drinking in 2025
item.description: Nearly 70% of the 23-year-olds binge drank at least once in the last year, with almost one in three doing so at least monthly. The post Nearly 70% of Gen Z Were Binge Drinking in 2025 appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ECR 2026: PARADIGM Trial: AI vs Radiologists in Prostate Cancer MRI
item.description: The PARADIGM study will test whether artificial intelligence can match radiologists in detecting clinically significant prostate cancer on MRI across an international cohort.
